title: Vel Sartha
subtitle: Rebel
description: Vel Sartha hailed from the planet Chandrila and was the cousin of Mon Mothma. When Luthen Rael masterminded the payroll heist from the Imperial garrison on Aldhani, it was Sartha who was tasked with executing the plan. Rael would drop a last-minute addition to the team in Cassian Andor, under the alias "Clem" - with Andor and Sartha among the job's few survivor. Seeing Casian as a loose end, Luthen would later task Vel with eliminating him.
